Based on travel time feasibility analysis using straight-line distance calculations:
• 0.95 (High): Very short travel distance (≤30% of max allowable)
• 0.85 (Moderate): Reasonable travel distance (≤50% of max allowable)
• 0.70 (Low): Concerning travel distance (≤99% of max allowable)
• 0.50 (Very Low): Maximum travel distance reached (100% of max allowable)
• 0.0 (None): Travel distance exceeds maximum allowable time

The score considers travel time from the technician's previous location to the work order location,
and from the work order location to their next scheduled location (if any).
